title: Frost ferns growing on window glass
purpose: Generate tileable maps of frost on glass: fern-like ice dendrites that branch at about 60 degrees from well-spaced seeds, with rime haze, in an albedo whose alpha is nearly opaque frost over nearly clear glass. Use as an overlay on windows, windscreens, freezer doors and icy props.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python frost_ferns.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: crystals
parameters.meaning: Crystal seeds in the tile (about; seeds keep a minimum spacing).

parameters.name: size
parameters.meaning: Length of a main stem in texture units.

parameters.name: branching
parameters.meaning: Chance of side branches at each step of a stem or branch.

parameters.name: levels
parameters.meaning: Branching depth: 1 bare needles, 2 branches, 3 branches with sub-branches.

parameters.name: curl
parameters.meaning: How much stems wander: 0 straight needles, 1 curling plumes.

parameters.name: haze
parameters.meaning: Fine rime haze between the crystals.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Fern frost: feathered plumes spreading across a window.

presets.name: needle_frost
presets.description: Dense straight needles with short spurs crossing at random.

presets.name: feathered
presets.description: Large dense plumes with sub-branches packed edge to edge.

presets.name: hoar_haze
presets.description: Heavy rime haze with small sparse crystals, almost fogged over.

limits: Growth is a stylized branching walk, not a diffusion-limited crystal growth simulation, so plumes are self-similar sketches of real fern frost. Crystals grow from scattered seeds rather than from the edges and scratches where frost usually starts. Branches finer than a pixel at the output size are skipped, so small outputs show the main plumes only. The alpha suits blending over a window; it does not model refraction or light scattering in the ice, and engines sort alpha-blended surfaces with other transparent ones.
technique_references: Bridson Poisson-disc seeds on the torus
Recursive dendrite growth with opposite side branches at hexagonal 60 degree angles
Capsule painting with wrap-around into a coverage field
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
